subject: AWS Marketplace: AMI naming, SKU visibility & product page copy (Acme Analytics)
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing: AMI & pricing clarity for Acme Analytics

Team —

Acme is almost ready to publish, but AWS raised two things that could block visibility: AMI tagging (we currently have two AMIs but they collapse under a generic name) and the pricing footnote language. I attached the latest product page draft and an AMI mapping CSV.

High level asks:
- Can we adopt the AMI naming pattern Ben suggested (redwood-{model}-{quant}-{region}) and update the mapping sent to AWS?
- Tighten the pricing footnote to make per-instance vs per-hour clear (legal flagged ambiguous wording).
- Move the primary CTA so the top hero CTA leads to a 1-click private offer flow (per Acme's procurement ask).

Timing: AWS wants final assets by EOD Friday so listing goes live next week.

Next steps: Ben to confirm AMI names and list of SKUs, Vanessa to review copy and hero CTA placement, Karthik to confirm legal-friendly pricing footnote. I'll coordinate with Emily (Acme) once we have a final draft.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: product_page_draft_v3.docx, ami_mapping_v2.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: AMI & pricing clarity for Acme Analytics

Sofia —

Quick pass below after reviewing the attached CSV. I also uploaded a small script to normalize AMI labels but I'm including the plain guidance here so we can hand this to AWS support:

Proposed AMI naming (canonical): redwood-{model}-{precision}-{region} e.g. redwood-vicuna-13b-int8-uswest-2
Notes:
- Keep model token short (vicuna, llama2, redwood-3b).
- Precision should be int8/float16/fp32.
- Region suffix required for AWS indexing.

SKUs: We should expose two SKUs on the listing: "standard" (shared capacity) and "dedicated-reserved" (reserved) — AWS's UI maps SKUs to pricing plans better than mixing instance-level tiers.

Pricing footnote suggestion (short): "List price reflects per-instance hourly rate for on-demand instances. Reserved capacity or private offers may be billed monthly as committed throughput; see private offer terms for billing cadence." Let legal expand if needed, but this clarifies per-instance vs committed billing.

I've attached an export of the AMI rows I think AWS will accept. Will follow up with a short screenshot for hero CTA placement.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Marketplace GTM, Redwood Inference

Attachments: ami_mapping_v2.csv

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acme-analytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Product page draft & AMI mapping (Acme)

Sofia —

Thanks for sending the draft. A couple quick items from procurement and engineering here at Acme:

- Procurement wants the CTA to explicitly say "Request private offer" rather than "Get started" so it maps to our internal procurement flow.
- Engineering asks that AMI names include the model size (13b, 70b) — we need deterministic naming for automation. Your pattern looks good but please ensure the size token is mandatory.
- For the pricing footnote, can you add a one-line example showing a sample hourly price + reserved commit (e.g., $X/hr vs $Y/month for reserved capacity)? That helps our finance team approve faster.

If you can send an updated draft by Friday morning PST we should be able to sign the private offer next week.

Emily Zhang
Head of Cloud Architecture
Acme Analytics

I'll coordinate the final upload to Seller Central and loop AWS marketplace support if they need different AMI metadata. Emily, we'll send the confirmed listing and the private offer doc for signature early next week.

Thanks everyone — tight timeline but doable.

Sofia
